Principal Policy Officer (EL1 Equivalent)  
 
  Location:   Canberra, ACT; Sydney, NSW; Melbourne, VIC; Brisbane, QLD  
  Hourly Rate:   $83.00 - $91.73 / hr + Super  
  Contract Length:   Initial 10-month contract (Possibility of a 12-month extension), hybrid  
  Security Clearance:   Baseline Security Clearance (Mandatory)  
 
  About the Role  
  Randstad is currently partnering with a prominent Federal Government Department to recruit a specialist   EL1 Principal Policy Officer  .  
  In this role, you will join the team to support an expanded work program focused on Vocational Education and Training (VET) to Higher Education pathways and outcomes. You will deliver evidence-based analysis and policy advice, design analytical frameworks, and leverage administrative datasets to ensure targeted, policy-relevant outputs.  
  Key Responsibilities  
 
  Research & Policy Advice:   Conduct independent and team-based research and analysis on VET to Higher Education pathways and outcomes to produce high-quality, evidence-based policy advice.  
  Framework Design:   Develop a consistent definition of VET-to-Higher Education pathways and design/apply analytical frameworks to guide data analysis.  
  Data & Analytics Support:   Collaborate with data analysts, economists, and data scientists to support data reporting, publication activities, and complex analysis.  
  Stakeholder Engagement:   Undertake complex stakeholder engagement to inform work program deliverables.  
  Reporting & Governance:   Produce defensible, clear, and accessible documentation and reports while adhering strictly to procurement, privacy, and data governance obligations.  
 
  Key Selection Criteria  
 
  Sector Knowledge:   Strong understanding of VET and Higher Education data, systems, and the broader tertiary education sector.  
  Data & Frameworks:   Proven capability to design analytical frameworks and experience working with large administrative datasets (experience with the   Person Level Integrated Data Asset / PLIDA   is highly desirable).  
  Collaboration:   Demonstrated ability to work effectively within multi-disciplinary teams alongside economists, data scientists, and junior policy analysts.  
  Stakeholder Management:   Proven track record in undertaking complex stakeholder engagement and translating findings into policy-relevant deliverables.  
  Communication & Governance:   Experience producing high-quality, defensible reports while maintaining strict compliance with secure handling of sensitive data and data governance.  
 
  Eligibility Requirements  
 
  Must be an Australian Citizen.  
  Must hold a current, active   Baseline Security Clearance   at minimum.  
 

 At Randstad, we are passionate about providing equal employment opportunities and embracing diversity to the benefit of all. We actively encourage applications from any background.

result.description: TRECS ELECTRICAL PTY LTD  Trecs Electrical Pty Ltd      Location:  Rockhampton, Queensland    Employment Type:  Full-time, Permanent   Hours:  38 hours per week   POSITION PURPOSE   The Electrician is responsible for installing, testing, commissioning, maintaining, repairing and modifying electrical systems, equipment and wiring for domestic, commercial and industrial clients. The role ensures all electrical work is completed safely, efficiently and in accordance with Australian Standards, statutory requirements and company procedures.            Benefits  Work vehicle   Task & responsibilities   KEY RESPONSIBILITIES   The Electrician will be responsible for, but not limited to:   Installing, testing, commissioning, maintaining and repairing electrical wiring, equipment, switchboards, lighting systems and electrical installations.  Reading and interpreting electrical drawings, wiring diagrams, specifications and technical documentation to determine installation requirements.  Measuring, marking out and installing electrical wiring, conduits, cables and associated equipment.  Connecting electrical systems, switchboards, distribution boards and equipment to power supplies.  Testing electrical installations using specialised testing equipment to verify safety, functionality and compliance with Australian Standards.  Diagnosing electrical faults and carrying out repairs or replacing defective wiring, equipment and components.  Installing and commissioning communications cabling, data cabling, security systems, smoke alarms and associated electrical equipment.  Installing electrical components associated with air conditioning systems in accordance with applicable licensing requirements.  Performing preventative and reactive maintenance on domestic, commercial and industrial electrical systems.  Conducting switchboard upgrades, lighting upgrades, power installations and electrical fit-outs for new and existing buildings.  Ensuring all work complies with the Electrical Safety Act, relevant Australian Standards, workplace health and safety requirements and company procedures.  Liaising with clients, builders, project managers and other trades to coordinate works and ensure projects are completed on time.  Completing job documentation, testing records, compliance certificates and service reports accurately.  Maintaining tools, equipment and company vehicles in a safe and serviceable condition.    Qualification & experience   SKILLS, QUALIFICATIONS AND EXPERIENCE    Essential    Certificate III in Electrotechnology Electrician (or equivalent recognised qualification).  Current Queensland Electrical Work Licence.  Minimum three (3) years' relevant post-qualification experience as an Electrician.  Demonstrated experience undertaking domestic, commercial and industrial electrical installations and maintenance.  Ability to read and interpret electrical plans, wiring diagrams and technical specifications.  Sound knowledge of the AS/NZS 3000 Wiring Rules and relevant Australian Standards.  Experience using electrical testing and diagnostic equipment.  Strong fault-finding and problem-solving skills.  Excellent communication and customer service skills.  Current unrestricted Australian Driver Licence.  Ability to work independently and as part of a team.    Desirable    Restricted or unrestricted Air Conditioning Licence.  Open Cabling Registration.  Experience installing data and communications cabling.  Experience installing CCTV, security and access control systems.  Elevated Work Platform (EWP), Working at Heights, CPR/LVR and White Card certifications.      About Company    Trecs Electrical Pty Ltd is a Queensland-based electrical contracting company providing high-quality domestic, commercial and industrial electrical services throughout Brisbane, Rockhampton and surrounding regions. The company specialises in electrical installations, maintenance, communications and data cabling, air conditioning installations, security systems, switchboard upgrades, lighting solutions and electrical services for new construction and refurbishment projects. Trecs Electrical is committed to delivering safe, reliable and efficient electrical solutions while maintaining the highest standards of workmanship and customer service.       Work Type:  Full time   Salary:  $83200-98200   Job Publish:  03-07-2026   Job Expire:  02-08-2026   Apply Link:  https://workinitiatives.com.au/job/details?id=5974803   This job is brought to you by workinitiatives.com.au.

 Whether you're looking for a contract, permanent role or are interested in a Section 26 transfer, we'd love to hear from you. 
   
 These positions will see you supporting employees through injury management and return-to-work programmes, while working closely with managers, health practitioners and other key stakeholders to achieve positive outcomes. 
   What you'll be doing    
 
 Managing rehabilitation and return-to-work cases 
 Developing and monitoring recovery-at-work plans 
 Providing advice around injury management and workplace adjustments 
 Liaising with employees, managers, medical providers and relevant stakeholders 
 Supporting a positive approach to employee wellbeing and recovery 
 Ensuring processes align with relevant legislation and policy frameworks 
 
   What we are looking for    
 We're keen to hear from people with experience in: 
   
 
 Rehabilitation and injury management 
 Return-to-work coordination 
 Case management 
 WHS or employee wellbeing 
 Workers compensation or Comcare environments 
 
 You'll be a strong communicator, comfortable building relationships with a variety of stakeholders and able to manage competing priorities in a fast-paced environment. 
   Security Clearance  
 An NV1 clearance would be fantastic, but it's certainly not essential. 
 Our client is open to building a pipeline of strong candidates who are eligible to obtain a clearance and willing to go through the process.  This could be a great opportunity for someone currently in a stable role or on a longer-term contract who is open to planning their next move. 
   What you'll get in return     
 
 Opportunities from APS5 through to EL1 equivalent levels 
 Contract, permanent and Section 26 options available 
 Supportive teams and meaningful work 
 Future career opportunities within the Federal Government sector 
 Competitive remuneration based on experience 
 
 If you're interested in learning more, apply now or reach out to the Hays Canberra team for a confidential chat.

Install, configure, test and maintain desktop computers, laptops, printers, scanners and other peripheral devices.  Install, configure and update operating systems, business applications and security software.  Monitor ICT systems to ensure efficient operation and optimal system performance. Perform routine system maintenance, software updates, backups and data recovery where required.  Configure and support email systems, cloud-based applications and remote access solutions. At least one year of relevant industry experience in ICT support, help desk or systems support. Applicants with extensive relevant experience may also be considered.  Demonstrated experience in troubleshooting Windows operating systems, Microsoft 365 applications, hardware and network connectivity issues.  Knowledge of LAN/WAN environments, networking principles, printers, peripherals and cloud-based technologies.  Excellent problem-solving, communication and customer service skills.  Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a fast-paced environment.  Relevant industry certifications (such as Microsoft, Cisco or CompTIA) will be highly regarded. result.description: The Trustee for R & C UNIT TRUST   Leading Hand Formwork Carpenter     Reports to : Project Manager / Site Manager   Direct Reports:  Carpenters / Apprentice / Construction Labourers / Trade Assistants       Position Summary   The Leading Hand Formwork Carpenter is responsible for carrying out hands-on formwork carpentry works while providing day-to-day supervision and guidance to small site crews on major energy infrastructure projects. The role involves constructing, installing and dismantling formwork systems, interpreting engineering drawings, coordinating daily work activities and ensuring works are completed safely, efficiently and in accordance with project specifications, quality standards and Work Health and Safety requirements.   Key Duties and Responsibilities   •    Read and interpret engineering drawings, specifications and construction plans for formwork and reinforced concrete structures.   •    Measure, cut, assemble, erect and dismantle timber, plywood and engineered formwork for footings, slabs, columns, walls, beams and other concrete structures.   •    Construct, install and maintain formwork systems in accordance with project specifications, Australian Standards and quality requirements.   •    Inspect completed formwork to ensure correct dimensions, alignment, bracing and structural integrity prior to concrete placement.   •    Carry out repairs, modifications and adjustments to formwork and temporary structures as required throughout the construction process.   •    Operate and maintain hand tools, power tools and construction equipment safely and efficiently.   •    Supervise and provide day-to-day guidance to a small team of carpenters and labourers, allocating tasks and monitoring work progress to ensure quality workmanship and timely project delivery.   •    Coordinate daily formwork activities with engineers, site supervisors, steel fixers, concreters and other trades to support efficient project outcomes.   •    Monitor the quality of completed carpentry works and rectify defects where required to ensure compliance with project specifications.   •    Assist with planning material requirements and ensure the safe handling, storage and use of construction materials on site.   •    Maintain a clean, safe and organised work area by identifying and reporting hazards and ensuring compliance with Work Health and Safety (WHS) legislation, Safe Work Method Statements (SWMS) and company policies.   •    Complete works within project timeframes while maintaining high standards of workmanship, safety and quality.   Skills, Experience and Qualifications   •    Certificate III in Carpentry (or equivalent overseas qualification), or a higher relevant qualification.   •    Demonstrated experience as a Formwork Carpenter.   •    Proven experience constructing, installing and dismantling formwork systems for reinforced concrete structures.   •    Experience supervising or leading small site crews and coordinating daily construction activities.   •    Sound ability to read and interpret engineering drawings, construction plans and technical specifications.   •    Strong knowledge of formwork systems, construction methods, Australian Standards and quality requirements.   •    Proficiency in the safe operation of hand tools, power tools and construction equipment.   •    Sound understanding of Work Health and Safety (WHS) legislation, Safe Work Method Statements (SWMS) and safe work practices.   •    Strong communication, leadership, teamwork and problem-solving skills with the ability to work effectively in a fast-paced construction environment.   •    Ability to work across multiple project locations, including FIFO/DIDO assignments, as required.   •    Current Construction Induction (White Card) and a valid driver's licence.  •    Additional industry licences or tickets (e.g. Working at Heights, Elevated Work Platform, Dogging, Rigging or First Aid) are advantageous.     About Company     About T&S Construct   T&S Construct is an Australian construction company specialising in formwork, concrete and structural construction services for major civil and energy infrastructure projects. The company delivers high-quality construction solutions across substations, transmission infrastructure, renewable energy developments and other large-scale projects, working collaboratively with principal contractors to achieve safe, efficient and compliant project outcomes.        Work Type:  Full time   Salary:  $90000-100000   Job Publish:  06-07-2026   Job Expire:  05-08-2026   Apply Link:  https://workinitiatives.com.au/job/details?id=5990066   This job is brought to you by workinitiatives.com.au.
